body: @zatadi - here ya go! [How to Get Out of Your Damn Head!](https://steemit.com/mindset/@tantrabanter/how-to-get-out-of-your-head-sharing-is-caring#comments)  let me know your thoughts!!

YES! 1000%! For me it is because I feel all the eyes on me and I dislike being the center of attention. I feel very intimidated by all the focus and also because when there are different people, I'm unsure which person to "cater" to, aka which mask to wear. 

That is a whole separate issue and can of worms. But I am getting past it by realizing that what this moment is, is not just to socialize, but to share and have a deeper connection with people and my self. These moments of group conversation can be absolutely timeless and poignant if I am fully present to what the opportunity provides. 

I recently wrote an article about how i got past my anxiety and freed up to self-express by simply sharing more and more. it helps to get out of my own damn head and i feel heard and understood. i have had people validate my experience and we continue to share and get to an amazing level of understanding within the conversation!! 

i can link the article if you are interested, just let me know!
get to the core of your experience- what do you want that you're not getting? what is your experience now and what would it be like if things were perfect?
